lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region, forming a regular 2D grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot rows at approximately 90-degree angles, creating distinct grid-like nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal dermal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the upper edge and shadows on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss and irregular scalloping on the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin, consistent with a major healed wound or predatory interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral side and a school of juvenile Gnathanodon speciosus (golden trevally) swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin.
